title: factory.config.json
description: Declares which assets an app needs. Lives in the target app's root. The app's own data module stays the single source of truth — this file only says how to read assets out of it.

dataSource.description: Path (relative to this config) of the module exporting the record array, e.g. src/data/foods.ts

dataExport.description: Named export holding the array. Defaults to the default export, or the only exported array.

idField.description: Record field used as the asset filename stem.

labelField.description: Record field shown as the human-readable heading in the prompt sheet. Defaults to idField.

groupField.description: Record field used to bucket the prompt sheet into sections, e.g. category.

promptSheet.description: Where `asset-factory prompts` writes the copy-paste markdown sheet.

styleGuide.description: Shared art direction appended to every image prompt.

items.description: Each entry turns every record into one asset.

kind.description: image = generated/imported picture; tts = synthesized voice-over.

name.description: Group name, used in state keys and reports. Defaults to kind.

outDir.description: Output folder, relative to the app root.

promptField.description: kind=image: record field holding the per-item art direction.

size.description: kind=image: output square edge in pixels.

textField.description: kind=tts: record field holding the text to read aloud.

voice.description: kind=tts: edge-tts voice, e.g. zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural. List them with `edge-tts --list-voices`.

rate.description: kind=tts: speaking rate offset, e.g. "-8%" to slow narration for young readers.
